purpose: Source-selection rules for the agent when MPSTATS overlaps internal MSP data and direct marketplace sources.

fallback: MPSTATS external/LK lookup only as discovery
precedence_rules.rule: Internal product_catalog is canonical. Never infer internal_article from MPSTATS labels.

fallback: MPSTATS self_redemption filters only as provider-side analytical aid
precedence_rules.rule: Internal self_purchase registry is canonical for company-defined self-purchase corrections.
Internal price journal is canonical for recorded company price-change history; MPSTATS histories are cross-checks/observed provider histories.
Prefer direct official/operational source when available because MPSTATS freshness/cache semantics are not yet fully benchmarked.

precedence_rules.intent: own WB/Ozon economics, funnel, trends, aggregated reports
precedence_rules.rule: MPSTATS is optimized for analytical read models; always state period and cabinet scope.

precedence_rules.intent: competitor, category, niche, brand, seller, external market research
preferred: MPSTATS wb_* / ozon_* / ym_* external analytics
precedence_rules.rule: MPSTATS is primary analytical source for external-market questions.
Snapshot only; do not claim historical trend from one call.

fallback: direct WB ads API if connected
precedence_rules.rule: Read-only analysis. Do not infer permission to change ads.
Read-only unless a separately verified write capability is later introduced.
Only on explicit creative user intent; never invoke from analytics automatically.

conflict_resolution: When two sources disagree, do not silently merge values. Report source, timestamp/period and likely freshness difference.
For internal identity and self-purchase classification, internal MSP data wins unless the user explicitly corrects it.
For execution proof (price changed, stock zeroed, ad paused), require direct post-action evidence; analytical data alone is insufficient.
For dated MPSTATS external analytics, never substitute today's date when the tool says data are available only through yesterday.
